question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher ________ another picture in the slide to explain his point of view.
solution:
The correct answer is "**inserted**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Insert" means to put something into something else**.(डालना)

 
 
• ​Example: You need to insert the debit card inside the ATM machine.
 
 
 
• **It is the most appropriate word in the given context as the teacher is adding another picture to the slide.**
 
• The sentence is in the past tense, so the correct form is "inserted".
 
• The sentence structure is in the active voice, with the teacher as the subject doing the action of inserting.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "excluded", means to leave something out or not include it.(छोड़ा गया)

 
 
• This is the opposite of what the teacher is doing in the sentence.
 
 
 
• Option 2, "extracted", means to remove something from something else.(निकाले)
 
 
• This does not make sense in the given context.
 
 
 
• Option 4, "obtained", means to acquire or get something.(प्राप्त किया)
 
 
• This is not the appropriate word as it does not convey the action of adding something to the slide.
